title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for chronic kidney disease.

HPI
The patient presents for a scheduled follow-up regarding their chronic kidney disease. The patient reports feeling generally well today, noting no significant new symptoms such as increased swelling in the lower extremities or changes in urinary output. They have been adherent to their current medication regimen and have been monitoring their blood pressure at home as instructed.

Medication List
Lisinopril 20mg daily, Amlodipine 5mg daily.

Exam
The patient is a well-appearing individual in no acute distress. Vital signs are stable. Physical examination reveals clear breath sounds and no audible wheezes. Heart sounds are regular with no murmurs. Extremities are without edema and capillary refill is brisk.

Assessment
1. Chronic kidney disease, stage 3a.

Plan
The patient will continue their current medications. We will proceed with routine laboratory monitoring, including serum creatinine and electrolytes, to track the progression of the chronic kidney disease. The patient was advised to maintain a low-sodium diet and follow up in three months for a repeat evaluation of their stage 3a status.

distractors.why: Stage 3a is documented; do not use unspecified stage 3.
